title: NSM — SOC KPI
description: MTTD, MTTR, daily alert volume, false-positive rate, ATT&CK coverage and the health of detections and data.

panels.title: MTTD (engine, median)

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(mttd_ms) AS mttd FROM nsm.validation_runs WHERE result = 'PASS' AND started_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.description: Replay start → Suricata alert, median of PASS rows in 30 days (testing/validate.sh, docs/kpi.md)

panels.title: Alert visible after (median)

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(visible_ms) / 1000 AS visible FROM nsm.validation_runs WHERE result = 'PASS' AND started_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.description: Replay start → queryable in ClickHouse (pipeline included)

panels.title: MTTR (evidence → block, median)

targets.rawSql: SELECT median(dateDiff('millisecond', a.evidence_at, p.applied_at)) / 1000 AS mttr FROM nsm.response_actions AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT applied_at, arrayJoin(added) AS range FROM nsm.response_applies WHERE mode = 'enforce' AND result = 'ok') AS p ON p.range = concat(a.ip, '/32') WHERE a.mode = 'enforce' AND a.action = 'block' AND a.trigger != 'manual' AND a.evidence_at IS NOT NULL AND p.applied_at >= a.created_at AND a.created_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND parseDateTime64BestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(a.detail, 'startsAt')) >= a.created_at - INTERVAL 20 MINUTE

panels.description: First evidence → firewall rule confirmed, automatic blocks in 30 days whose Grafana alert started within 20 min of the decision. Blocks decided from a repeat notification of an older alert are not detection latency (docs/kpi.md)

panels.title: Daily alert volume

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(n)) AS per_day FROM (SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS d, count() AS n FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE in_iface = 'ens4' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND toDate(timestamp) < today() GROUP BY d)

panels.description: Average Suricata alerts per complete day over the last 7 days

panels.title: FP rate (reviewed pairs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(sv.latest_verdict = 'false_positive') / count() AS fp_rate FROM (SELECT subject, argMax(verdict, created_at) AS latest_verdict FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'suricata' GROUP BY subject) AS sv WHERE sv.subject IN (SELECT DISTINCT concat(toString(alert_signature_id), '|', src_ip) FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE in_iface = 'ens4')

panels.description: False-positive signature/source pairs ÷ reviewed pairs (the unit of triage). Counted per alert, the noise already suppressed by tuning dominates — see the table below. Verdicts cover reviewed severity-1 pairs and tuned noise, not a random sample

panels.title: ATT&CK coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(status = 'validated') / count() AS coverage FROM nsm.attack_coverage WHERE in_target

panels.description: Target techniques with a validated detection (detections/attack-targets.tsv; detections/attack-layer.py)

panels.title: Daily alert volume

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS time, concat('severity ', toString(alert_severity)) AS level, count() AS alerts FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4' GROUP BY time, level ORDER BY time

panels.description: Suricata alerts per day by severity

panels.title: Daily response decisions

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, concat(action, ' · ', mode) AS decision, count() AS decisions FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND mode != 'test' GROUP BY time, decision ORDER BY time

panels.description: Blocks, observations, rejections and releases per day (dry-run until 2026-09-15 04:14 UTC)

panels.title: False-positive rate by source

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Suricata (by reviewed pair)' AS source, countIf(sv.latest_verdict = 'true_positive') AS true_positives, countIf(sv.latest_verdict = 'false_positive') AS false_positives, round(100 * countIf(sv.latest_verdict = 'false_positive') / count(), 1) AS fp_rate_pct FROM (SELECT subject, argMax(verdict, created_at) AS latest_verdict FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'suricata' GROUP BY subject) AS sv WHERE sv.subject IN (SELECT DISTINCT concat(toString(alert_signature_id), '|', src_ip) FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE in_iface = 'ens4') UNION ALL SELECT 'Suricata (by alert, incl. tuned noise)' AS source, countIf(sv.latest_verdict = 'true_positive') AS true_positives, countIf(sv.latest_verdict = 'false_positive') AS false_positives, round(100 * countIf(sv.latest_verdict = 'false_positive') / count(), 1) AS fp_rate_pct FROM nsm.suricata_alert AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT subject, argMax(verdict, created_at) AS latest_verdict FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'suricata' GROUP BY subject) AS sv ON sv.subject = concat(toString(a.alert_signature_id), '|', a.src_ip) WHERE a.in_iface = 'ens4' UNION ALL SELECT 'Behavior detections (by finding)', countIf(dv.latest_verdict = 'true_positive'), countIf(dv.latest_verdict = 'false_positive'), round(100 * countIf(dv.latest_verdict = 'false_positive') / count(), 1) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT hit_key FROM nsm.detection_hits) AS f INNER JOIN (SELECT subject, argMax(verdict, created_at) AS latest_verdict FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'detection' GROUP BY subject) AS dv ON dv.subject = f.hit_key

panels.description: Behavior detections on a server with no compromise have only produced benign findings so far — each tuned in docs/tuning-log.md

panels.title: Detection health (latest run)

targets.rawSql: SELECT detection_id AS detection, argMax(result, run_at) AS last_result, argMax(hits, run_at) AS last_hits, argMax(duration_ms, run_at) AS last_duration_ms, max(run_at) AS last_run, dateDiff('minute', max(run_at), now64(3)) AS minutes_ago, countIf(result = 'error' AND run_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS errors_24h FROM nsm.detection_runs WHERE NOT backfill GROUP BY detection ORDER BY detection

panels.description: A detection that stops running shows up here before anyone misses its findings (hourly at :07)

panels.title: ATT&CK coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT technique_id AS technique, name AS technique_name, tactic, status AS coverage, arrayStringConcat(detections, ', ') AS validated_by, arrayStringConcat(observed_by, ', ') AS observed FROM nsm.attack_coverage WHERE in_target ORDER BY indexOf(['gap', 'observed', 'validated'], coverage), technique

panels.description: Layer for ATT&CK Navigator: detections/attack-map.json. gap = in scope but nothing detects it yet

panels.title: Validation runs (PCAP harness)

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at, case_name AS test_case, attack_technique AS technique, result AS outcome, mttd_ms, visible_ms, rules_loaded FROM nsm.validation_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 40

panels.description: Each row is one replayed attack through the production pipeline

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, latest, dateDiff('second', latest, now64(3)) AS lag_s FROM ( SELECT 'zeek_conn' AS source, max(ts) AS latest FROM nsm.zeek_conn UNION ALL SELECT 'suricata_alert', max(timestamp) FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE in_iface = 'ens4' UNION ALL SELECT 'suricata_stats', max(timestamp) FROM nsm.suricata_stats UNION ALL SELECT 'cowrie_events (honeypot)', max(timestamp) FROM nsm.cowrie_events UNION ALL SELECT 'detection_runs', max(run_at) FROM nsm.detection_runs WHERE NOT backfill UNION ALL SELECT 'vector_internal_metrics', max(timestamp) FROM nsm.vector_internal_metrics ) ORDER BY lag_s DESC
